reasoning: A standard UI glyph showing an arrow leaving a bracket, universally read as 'log out', 'exit', or 'export'. While clear in software interfaces, it applies to a narrow slice of real-world to-do tasks (mostly signing out of accounts, exporting data, or checking out) and is easily confused with login or import icons.
